mutations.name: confirmed lines are never read
kills: f11Report clock 2 (webhook) matches a webhook row by a timestamped reconciler.confirmed line, and not by a delivery retry or an unknown answer

mutations.name: the input's withinMs is ignored
kills: f11Report clock 2 (webhook) takes withinMs from the input, so a confirm later than it leaves the row webhookOnly

mutations.name: a log line at since is out of the window
kills: f11Report clock 2 (webhook) ignores log lines outside [since, until) and counts untimed ones instead of placing them

mutations.name: windows are compared by raw use
kills: f11Report peaks compares windows by share of their limit, not by raw use

mutations.name: one unstamped record refuses an otherwise placed log
kills: f11Report log counts and markdown refuses a log none of whose records can be placed in the window, and accepts one with any placed record
